chunks: And it is narrated from Abān, from Bashshār, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
The first drop of the martyr’s blood is an expiation for his sins, except debt, for its expiation is its repayment.
ai.seo_question: Does martyrdom erase all sins, including unpaid debt?
ai.summary: This hadith states that martyrdom expiates sins from the very first drop of blood. However, debt is excluded, because the right attached to it is only cleared by repayment.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3688 - It is narrated from Aban, from Bashshar, from Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said: "
The first drop of the martyr's blood is an expiation for his sins-except for debt, for its expiation is its repayment."
